policy.purpose: Vendor public-domain patristic editions into the repository so readers do not depend on external sites at runtime.
rules: Only import editions verified as public domain or otherwise explicitly licensed for redistribution.
Preserve edition, translator, publication year, upstream identifier, and provenance.
Do not represent fragmentary works as complete.
Do not import modern copyrighted translations without permission.

lost_or_fragmentary.title: Hexapla
lost_or_fragmentary.note: The original Hexapla does not survive complete. The local library must contain only verified surviving fragments/reconstructions and must never label them as the complete Hexapla.
